    return None

import random

def is_harmonious(matrix):
    m = len(matrix)
    X = [frozenset(row) for row in matrix]
    Y = [frozenset(matrix[i][j] for i in range(m)) for j in range(m)]
    return len(set(X) | set(Y)) == 2 * m

def solve_small(m, n, trials=1000000):
    for _ in range(trials):
        matrix = [[random.randint(1, n) for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(m)]
        if is_harmonious(matrix):
            return True
    return False
